info.description: One paper that is sold on its own, e.g. NV (New Vision daily) or NVW (New Vision weekend). `title` groups publications of the same paper on the reader landing page. Every edition belongs to one publication, and every entitlement opens exactly one publication. Managed from handle (Publications page).

code.description: Short upper-case code used in URLs (/nv/2026-10-23), SKUs and reports. Never change it once editions exist.

title.description: The paper's name readers know, e.g. 'New Vision'. Publications with the same title share one card on the landing page.

name.description: Full name of this publication, e.g. 'New Vision weekend'.

editionLabel.description: Short label on the landing page row, e.g. 'Daily' or 'Weekend'.

category.description: Section on the reader landing page: Newspapers, Pullouts and supplements, Magazines, Other.

coverDays.description: How many days one edition covers, starting on its date. Daily = 1; a weekend edition dated Saturday = 2 (Saturday and Sunday). Publications with no set release date use 1: each issue covers its own date.

scheduleNote.description: Shown to readers, e.g. 'Mon–Fri' or 'Sat–Sun'. Leave empty when there is no set release date.

active.description: Inactive publications are hidden from readers; existing access keeps working.
